name: K1a
prompt:
ALUM AMAN COLLAGE STYLE (fixed house look of reel 006, ink swapped to teal): a hand-made editorial collage. Real candid black-and-white documentary photographs (35mm Kodak Tri-X look, heavy natural grain, natural light, real Saudi people and real places) are cut out and printed as coarse halftone riso prints on cool light grey paper #F0F1F2, with torn edges, masking tape and paper fibres. A second riso ink layer in teal #0199a2 (and deep teal #017a82 for shadows) is slightly mis-registered behind the cut-outs. Over the collage, an art director has drawn by hand with a thick teal marker: circles, arrows, a dashed selection box with square corner handles, and a black mouse cursor. Teal is used ONLY on the one object that matters in the moment plus the marker marks; everything else is black, grey and paper. Visible film grain and print noise over everything. Calm empty paper in the top quarter of the frame for typography. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Never glossy, never CGI, never plastic skin, never a photoreal 3D render.
Vertical 9:16. One continuous world: the inside of a villa majlis room in Al-Ahsa, Saudi Arabia, a plain plastered wall with ONE tall window opening, seen frontally from inside the room; outside the window, palm trees and a desert dust storm. KEYFRAME 1 (the measure): same wall, same frontal framing, a little closer. The old window has been torn out like paper: torn paper edges around an EMPTY opening, the storm and palms visible through it. A hand-drawn teal marker dashed selection box with four square corner handles fits the opening exactly, a teal marker dimension line with arrow ends runs across the top edge of the opening, and a black mouse cursor sits on the lower-right handle. No man in this frame. A few teal halftone dust dots still drift in. Use the two attached reference images ONLY for the medium (halftone cut-out collage on paper, grain, tape, hand marker marks). Recolour every accent: NO green anywhere, the only accent ink is teal #0199a2. Paper is cool neutral light grey #F0F1F2, NOT beige, NOT warm. Generate exactly 1 vertical 9:16 image, Nano Banana, no questions.
